brief_rationale: The doctor’s trajectory fulfills all 8 responsibility-chain items without serious error, discovers and reconciles the left/right laterality confusion (HO2), co-designs a low-burden family execution system adapted to rotating caregivers (HO1), and closes with explicit bounded risk separation and caregiver teach-back (HO3). No minor or serious in-chain error is present, and no important non-chain defect is identified. The model actively used workspace queries and family dialogue to trigger and complete at least three high-order points with meaningful impact, and the final exchange obtains caregiver receipt of a simple wall/pill-box plan. The highest applicable grade boundary is 5 (Perfect).

All residual uncertainties are classified as allowed with a verification pathway, and no blocking residual remains unaddressed.
